title: RoleWorld: Knowledge Transfer in World Modeling with Functional Role Abstractions
abstract: arXiv:2610.13172v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: World models enable large language model (LLM) agents to anticipate action effects and make informed decisions. For generalization, it is desirable for such world models to transfer efficiently to new environments with similar interaction structure and underlying dynamics. Recent approaches encode world dynamics as symbolic rules or executable programs, whose compositional structure in principle affords transfer, but still organize such knowledge around environment-specific objects. To address this limitation, we introduce RoleWorld, a symbolic world modeling approach which uses reusable prototypes and environment-specific parameter values as functional role abstractions to represent how objects behave in interactions. From interaction trajectories, a teacher LLM extracts role prototypes and executable transition rules defined over role instances, together with a skill that guides the actor LLM to use role information in decision making.

translated_title: RoleWorld：基于功能角色抽象的世界建模知识迁移
translated_abstract: 世界模型使大语言模型（LLM）智能体能够预判动作效果并做出明智决策。为了实现泛化，理想情况下这类世界模型应当能够高效迁移到具有相似交互结构和底层动力学的新环境中。近期的方法将世界动力学编码为符号规则或可执行程序，其组合结构在原则上支持迁移，但这些方法仍然围绕环境特定的对象来组织此类知识。为解决这一局限性，我们提出了RoleWorld，这是一种符号世界建模方法，它使用可复用的原型和环境特定的参数值作为功能角色抽象，来表示对象在交互中的行为方式。从交互轨迹中，一个教师LLM提取角色原型以及定义在角色实例上的可执行转移规则，同时还提取一个引导行动者LLM在决策中使用角色信息的技能。
tldr: RoleWorld提出一种以功能角色抽象（可复用原型与环境特定参数值）为核心组织世界动力学知识的符号世界建模方法，使世界模型能够高效迁移到具有相似交互结构的新环境中。
en_tdlr: RoleWorld is a symbolic world modeling approach that organizes world dynamics knowledge through functional role abstractions—reusable prototypes with environment-specific parameters—enabling efficient transfer of world models to new environments with similar interaction structures.
